name: Insurance Data Set 1
definition: Formal document used to record a fact and used as proof of the fact that goods have been insured under an insurance policy.

Issuer.name: Issuer
Issuer.definition: Issuer of the certificate, typically the insurance company or its agent.

EffectiveDate.name: Effective Date
EffectiveDate.definition: Date upon which cover under an insurance policy becomes effective.

PlaceOfIssue.name: Place Of Issue
PlaceOfIssue.definition: Place where the insurance certificate was issued.

Transport.name: Transport
Transport.definition: Transport information relative to the goods that are insured under the insurance policy.

InsuredAmount.name: Insured Amount
InsuredAmount.definition: Value of the goods as insured under the insurance policy.

InsuredGoodsDescription.name: Insured Goods Description
InsuredGoodsDescription.definition: Information about the goods and/or services of a trade transaction.

InsuranceConditions.name: Insurance Conditions
InsuranceConditions.definition: Description of the conditions and exclusion clauses under which insurance is granted.

InsuranceClauses.name: Insurance Clauses
InsuranceClauses.definition: Standard insurance clauses defined by the Institute of London Underwriters (or the American Institute of marine Underwriters).

Assured.name: Assured
Assured.definition: Party that is covered under the assurance policy.

ClaimsPayableAt.name: Claims Payable At
ClaimsPayableAt.definition: Place where claims under the insurance policy will be paid.

ClaimsPayableIn.name: Claims Payable In
ClaimsPayableIn.definition: Currency in which claims, if valid, will be paid.

IssueDateOrEffectiveDateRule.definition: At least one of IssueDate or EffectiveDate must be present.
